heading: Notes from Simran
intro: Messages to the people who’ve been there all along.
disclaimer: Every note is published only in Simran’s own words, as supplied by her team.

notes.body:
Seeing our hard work translate into success is a dream come true. The way you have embraced our film, has left me exhilarated. Your enthusiasm and appreciation make all the late nights worth it.

I want to take a moment to thank each one of you from the bottom of my heart. Your love and support mean the world to me and the entire team of “Tiger 3”.
notes.preview: “Seeing our hard work translate into success is a dream come true.”

notes.greet: Reaching For The Stars, In Cinema And In Science
notes.body:
And as if the universe were celebrating with us “Rocketry,” which pays tribute to India’s early space pioneers, has won a National Film Award. I am beyond honored.

Here’s to reaching for the stars, in cinema and in science.

I’m thrilled to have been nominated for the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress for my performance in ‘Rocketry.’

But most importantly, I want to thank my fans for their unwavering encouragement and support of me.
notes.preview: “I want to thank my fans for their unwavering encouragement.”

notes.body:
Today, I’m reflecting on two remarkable parts of my cinematic journey – the 21st anniversary of Thamizh and the 20th anniversary of Arasu. As I look back on these milestones, I’m filled with immense gratitude and joy.

Here’s to the magic of cinema and the unforgettable memories.
notes.preview: “I’m filled with immense gratitude and joy.”
